svg.aria-label: Interactive Living Treehouse inside an Enchanted Forest

g.data-room-desc: Read-only timeline of completed move runs and scan audit logs.
Browse top-level source images & videos safely with rule hints.
Scan faces, build your organization preview, and Approve SHA-256 moves.
View discovered people cards, name groups, split or merge safely.
Dashboard overview: indexed media counts, people summary, recent activity.
Policy lock: duplicate detection & file deletion are intentionally disabled.
Safely reverse the previous run with SHA-256 verification (Undo).
